subject: vt-dy
title: VT.DY.-----DIS.C.CT.
description: Chart 1 of 2 on book p. 493 (MP(II)-11). VT-DY (vibrational dynamics) is the subject; DIS-C-CT (disintegration of a culture’s center) is the partner. From the subject: TR (transformation), POL-DY (political dynamics) and INFO-COMP (information compression). From TR: EXP-DY (expansion dynamics). From POL-DY: PART (participation). From INFO-COMP: AFN (affinity negation). From EXP-DY: T-C-IMP (time continuum implications). From PART: ECO-DYM (economic dynamics). From AFN: IF-SPT (infra-spirituality). From ECO-DYM: POL-P (political policies).
